Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of THE COMMANDING OFFICER, INS KOSWARI payable at KARWAR . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of THE COMMANDING OFFICER, INS KOSWARI payable at KARWAR . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Following documents are to be submitted alongwith the bid documents. Non submission of the same by th e bidder will be liable for disqualification from bidding process: 1. GST Registration Certificate. 2. Past Experience towards supply and installation of Induction Cooking Range with oven in Govt Estb/Ship s. 3. Annual Turnover and ITR of last 3 years. 4. Design and diagram/photo of the Induction Cooking Range Offered by the firm. 5. Undertaking towards providing one year warranty for the Induction Cooking Range. 6. Pre-Bid Meeting is mandatory to be attended to ascertain the scope of requirement/work for efficient qu
oting of bid value. Note: The Induction Cooking Range is to be delivered and installed onboard. .
